title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing core.create check in form creation in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3,…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla extension 'vi-solutions' Visforms versions 1.0.0-5.6.3 and 6.0.0-6.2.0 allows backend users without create permissions to create forms due to a missing core.create permission check in the createForm task.
